messages:
Marta: Handing off NewHorizon Diagnostics to CS. Closed today. ARR $42k. They requested Private (VPC) + SAML SSO + strict PHI controls. Sales noted pilot window = 3 weeks, renewal baseline Apr 2027 (flagged).

Theo: Thanks @Marta  I'll take CSM. Who's their technical contact and what's the earliest kickoff?

Marta: Tech lead is Priyanka Rao (priya@newhorizon.io). Earliest kickoff next Tue. Sales captured pilot KPIs: p95 < 65ms for 256-token generate, embeddings 250/min, error < 0.5%. Pilot cap applied.

Luis: Support Eng here. I'll own runbook and eng escalation. Need SAML metadata, VPC CIDR, and decision on KMS (CMK vs Redwood). Also legal wants a data segregation checklist for PHI.

Marta: Priyanka indicated they prefer customer-managed KMS but will accept Redwood KMS for pilot. SAML metadata pending from their IdP. Legal asked for logs retention 30 days for pilot.

Anika: I'll be infra lead for Redwood side. Need CIDR and preferred peering window. Proposed default config for the pilot cluster:
```
cluster: nh-pilot-1
GPUs: 1xA10G
quant: int8
cache: disabled (PHI validation)
SLO: p95 <= 80ms
```

Luis: Alert thresholds draft: error rate > 0.75% over 5m -> page oncall; p95 > 150ms -> notify eng; p99 > 500ms -> page. Creating NH-ENG-1 ticket and will attach runbook template.

Theo: Enablement asks: 30-min infra walkthrough for Priyanka and her SRE (week1), 45-min product session for their ML lead. Also we'll run two short feedback surveys: after initial validation and end of pilot (3 questions each).

Marta: Sales note: if pilot usage > 70% of cap sales will discuss Dedicated commit and predictability pricing. Also there's a negotiated exception for a one-time support window during launch.

Anika: Action items list:
- Theo: schedule kickoff + enablement with Priyanka (by EOD Fri) :calendar: 
- Marta: share contract excerpt + pilot acceptance criteria (done) :white_check_mark: 
- Luis: create NH-ENG-1 and post runbook draft (today) :gear: 
- Anika: send VPC + peering template to Priyanka (by Mon) :email: 

ops-bot: Created ticket NH-ENG-1 assigned to Luis. Noted: provisioning on hold until CIDR and SAML metadata received.

Luis: Runbook notes I'll include in NH-ENG-1:
- onboarding smoke tests and scripts
- sample log format for parser validation
- escalation order: oncall -> Luis -> Anika -> Theo
- rollback play for quick isolation

Anika: Once CIDR arrives I'll request peering and provisioning. If they ask for KMS CMK/HSM during pilot, we need procurement lead time.

Theo: Renewal ops: marking medium risk until PHI checklist completed. If pilot KPIs met early, we'll propose early upsell to Dedicated. I'll tag in Salesforce and set a Q1 2027 renewal touch.

Marta: Headcount note: include SE Miguel on kickoff for integration help.

Luis: I'll post the initial runbook link in NH-ENG-1 in ~2 hours and add the alerting rules to the ticket.

Theo: Thanks team. I'll follow up with Priyanka and close the handoff thread after kickoff. :rocket:
